map.查询不同材质文物的温湿度保存标准，判断展柜实测值是否达标: Look up temperature and humidity preservation standards for different artifact materials, and judge whether the showcase measured values meet them
map.📖 查看「展柜温湿度监控 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Showcase Temperature & Humidity Monitor
map.文物入库/布展前，按材质（金属/陶瓷/书画/丝织/漆木等）查对应推荐温湿度范围，: Before artifacts enter storage / exhibition, look up the recommended temperature and humidity range by material (metal/ceramic/painting-calligraphy/silk/lacquer-wood, etc.), and verify whether the showcase measured temperature and humidity meet the standard.
map.环境超标告警时，给出针对性调控建议（升温/降温、加湿/除湿）直至回到达标区间。: When an environment exceeds the limit and alarms, give targeted control advice (heat/cool, humidify/dehumidify) until it returns to the compliant range.
map.某书画类展品推荐温度 18~20℃、湿度 50~55%。实测 19℃、52% →: A painting-calligraphy exhibit recommends temperature 18~20℃, humidity 50~55%. Measured 19℃, 52% → both temperature and humidity fall in range, judged "compliant"; if measured 22℃, 45%, then temperature exceeds the 20℃ upper limit (judged non-compliant, advise cooling below 20℃), and humidity, though near the 50~55% lower bound, is low. Metal requires humidity <40% to prevent rust, painting-calligraphy requires 50~55% to prevent drying cracks; the two standards must not be mixed.
map.不同材质温湿度为什么差别这么大？: Why do temperature and humidity differ so much by material?
map.材质吸湿/热胀特性不同：金属/皮革怕潮（金属<40%、皮革 50~60%），书画: Materials differ in moisture absorption / thermal expansion: metal/leather fear damp (metal <40%, leather 50~60%), painting-calligraphy/silk fear dryness and light (50~55% and low illuminance), lacquer-wood-bamboo needs moisture (55~65%) to prevent cracking. Mixed storage neglects one for another; control must be by material in separate cases.
map.短期剧烈温湿波动会引发材料反复胀缩、凝结水与霉变，比均值偏差更伤文物。行业要求温: Short-term drastic temperature and humidity fluctuations cause repeated material expansion/contraction, condensation and mold, harming artifacts more than mean deviation. The industry requires daily temperature fluctuation ≤±2~3℃, humidity ≤±5%, needing continuous monitoring rather than only instantaneous values.
map.关于「展柜温湿度监控」: About the Showcase Temperature & Humidity Monitor
map.按材质取推荐温湿度：温度为区间数组或 tempR 时判定实测温度落在区间内，否则: The recommended temperature and humidity are taken by material: when the temperature is a range array or tempR, the measured temperature is checked against the range, otherwise it is treated as room temperature and passes by default; when humidity is a range array or rhR, it is checked against the range, when only rhMax is present it is checked against the upper limit, and otherwise it is not assessed; overall compliance = both temperature and humidity compliant; when not compliant, specific advice is given for heating / cooling and humidifying / dehumidifying; the daily fluctuation items for temperature and humidity are recorded but not judged
map.按文物材质调取温湿度保存标准，比对实测温湿度判定瞬时值是否达标并给出调控建议；日: Look up temperature and humidity preservation standards by artifact material and judge whether the instantaneous measured values pass, with adjustment advice; daily fluctuation tolerance is recorded for reference only and is not part of the verdict; standards are common reference values, subject to the institution's own specifications.
map.日常监测时，记录温湿度日波动作为人工巡检参考（本工具仅判定瞬时温湿度，不对日波动: During daily monitoring, record temperature and humidity fluctuations as a reference for manual inspection (this tool only judges instantaneous temperature and humidity and does not automatically judge fluctuation tolerance), preventing metal corrosion, paper embrittlement and wood cracking.
